newsitem.title: LATVIA: SAULES INSTA-TELLER NETWORK TO DOUBLE IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: SAULES INSTA-TELLER NETWORK TO DOUBLE IN 1997.

text.p: Saules Bank, Latvia's ninth biggest by way of assets, said on Monday that it plans to double its insta-teller network to 40 in 1997, aiming at the two main cities, Riga and Daugavpils.

"The number of Saules insta-tellers is planned to reach 40 by the end of 1997, most of them in the capital Riga and two to three in Daugavpils and Juramala respectively," a bank spokesman told Reuters.
Cash can be withdrawn from the machines 24 hours a day and payments to utility providers are expected to be added to the service list during this year, the spokesman said.
"We have already installed 24 machines, all but one in Riga and the other in Jurmala," he added.
The tellers handle edc/Maestro, Eurocard/MasterCard, Eurocheque and Cirrus cards.
